name: @sapphirus/bmad-foundation
description: Hash-locked, first-party BMAD Method and Builder semantic foundation.

scripts.preflight: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p=require('./package.json');const a=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(process.version.slice(1)!==p.engines.node)throw new Error('Node toolchain drift');if(!a.includes('pnpm/'+p.engines.pnpm+' '))throw new Error('pnpm toolchain drift');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('./tests').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.test.mjs'))){const s=fs.readFileSync('./tests/'+f,'utf8');if(/(?:^|[^A-Za-z0-9_$])(?:test|it|describe)\.(?:skip|todo|only)\s*\(/u.test(s))throw new Error('focused or skipped test: '+f)}"
